method.signal: median absolute grayscale difference between adjacent radii over all sampled angles
method.purpose: Prefer circumferentially persistent radial edges over local text/symbol edges.

interpretation: Eight radial positions, including the previously split 162-170 family, show circumferential persistence far stronger than secondary peaks.
RB-01 through RB-07 each exceed 85% angular coverage for edge magnitude >30; RB-00 is weaker but still persistent across ~80% of angles.
These measurements strongly support real circular/radial structural boundaries, but do not yet determine semantic ring identity or AK cardinality.
The close RB-00/RB-01 pair must be treated as two measured edges until source geometry proves they are the two sides of one border/stroke or distinct structural boundaries.
